rationale: The requested repository change adds gate-rationale and localized Why projection behavior, but no approved durable UR or Brownfield decision is present. Fail-closed routing therefore permits only the UR stage; this classification grants no authority or approval.
decision_grounds: The task requests a functional and localized interaction change in an existing AGDF repository.
Control-state context explicitly states that no approval or Brownfield decision is present.
Canonical gate routing says the earliest blocking gate wins and new functional or user-visible behavior requires a valid
durable UR before Brownfield Review or later stages.
Missing control state must remain fail-closed.
Compact Delivery is not eligible because visible approved UR, completed Brownfield analysis, and stored quick_task
